answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, diluted when peers disagree, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The ember of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the karst of a task receipt, and the prism is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
